modalities.evidence: The database consists of ECG recordings from 104 patients
variability of heart rhythm and waveform morphology

output.population: 104 patients receiving elective PTCA in one of the major coronary arteries; patients with ventricular tachycardia, emergency procedures, or signal loss were excluded
output.summary: ECG recordings acquired during elective percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty procedures using single prolonged balloon inflation, capturing inter-patient variability in heart rhythm and waveform morphology.
